proposal.hypothesis: Staging each source chunk once in shared memory allows the CTA's 256 target threads to reuse those source values, potentially reducing repeated global-memory traffic while keeping one target and one accumulated output per thread. The controller must measure whether that reuse benefits the official sizes.

retained: Use a 256-particle dynamic shared-memory source tile per CTA, matching the 256-thread block.
Cooperatively load each source chunk, synchronize before reuse, and synchronize before overwriting the tile.
Keep one target and force accumulator per thread; handle tail threads without bypassing barriers and bound the final partial tile.
Exclude self-interactions using the global source index and reserve 7168 bytes of dynamic shared memory in the launch configuration.
